image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a translucent green plastic disposable lighter lying on a dark surface. The lighter features a colorful graphic print on its side depicting a stylized blue and orange butterfly or abstract shape. There is black text printed near the top edge, which appears to be reversed or mirrored (e.g., 'KISS' looks like 'SSIK'). A portion of another object (possibly a bottle cap) is visible in the top left corner.

artifact_observations.location: Top edge of the lighter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The black text printed on the lighter is nonsensical and appears mirrored or garbled (e.g., characters are reversed or malformed). This is a common AI artifact where text generation fails to produce legible, correctly oriented strings.

The butterfly/abstract graphic has slightly soft, bleeding edges into the green plastic background, lacking the crisp decal application seen in real manufactured products. The colors blend slightly unnaturally.
The geometry of the metal hood is slightly vague and lacks sharp mechanical definition. The spark wheel texture is indistinct, appearing more like a smooth bump than a textured metal wheel.
